summary: Trost is sealed and still full of the dead. Eren wakes in custody, and the Survey Corps arrives to argue for the weapon he has become.

segments.ja: 穴は閉まりました。それでもトロスト区は、勝った街の顔をしていません。通りには巨人の死体と、人間の死体が同じ向きで残っています。駐屯兵団は回収の仕事に入ります。刃、遺体、名前の分かるものと分からないもの。煙の匂いが壁の上まで昇ってきます。作戦の成功は、この回収が終わるまで、誰の口にもうまく乗りませんでした。
segments.en: The hole was closed. Trost District still did not look like a city that had won. Titan corpses and human corpses lay on the same streets, facing the same way. The Garrison began the work of recovery. Blades, bodies, names that could be read and names that could not. The smell of smoke climbed as far as the top of the wall. Success did not sit easily in anyone's mouth until that work was finished. It was not finished.

segments.ja: ジャン・キルシュタインは、回収の列の中でマルコ・ボットを探していました。訓練兵団で、ジャンが自分の弱さを隠すたびに、マルコはそれを笑わずに聞いていました。今、その顔が名簿にありません。ジャンは屋根と通りを往復し、同じ場所を二度見ます。見つからないことは、まだ死ではない、と自分に言います。でも回収の仕事は、見つからない人を長く待ってはくれません。
segments.en: Jean Kirstein walked the recovery line looking for Marco Bott. In the Training Corps, whenever Jean hid how afraid he was, Marco listened and did not laugh. Now that face was not on the list. Jean went from roof to street and looked at the same place twice. He told himself that missing was not yet death. The work of recovery does not wait long for a missing person.

segments.ja: エレン・イェーガーは、巨人のうなじから人間の形で引き出されました。片腕と片足はなく、体は熱のあとで震えています。ミカサは血を拭き、アルミンは息があるかを数えます。二人とも、友達を回収しているのか、兵器の中身を回収しているのか、言葉にできません。意識のないエレンの顔は、昨日の作戦のときより幼く見えました。周りの兵は、その顔を長く見ないようにします。
segments.en: Eren Jaeger was pulled out of the Titan's nape in a human shape. One arm and one leg were gone, and the body shook with the heat it had left. Mikasa wiped blood. Armin counted breaths. Neither of them could say whether they were recovering a friend or recovering the inside of a weapon. Eren's unconscious face looked younger than it had during yesterday's operation. The soldiers around them tried not to look at it for long.

segments.ja: 回収の合間に、兵たちは低い声で話します。巨人はなぜ人を食うのか。腹は空なのか、それとも原初の欲求として、ただ人間のほうへ歩くのか。意思があるなら、エレンの中にも同じものがいるのか。意思がないなら、昨日岩を持ち上げた力は何だったのか。答えは出ません。ただ、この問いが街の中に残ると、エレンを普通の負傷兵として置けなくなることだけは明らかでした。
segments.en: Between loads of the dead, the soldiers talked in low voices. Why does a Titan eat a person. Is it hunger, or a primal desire that only walks toward humans. If a Titan has a will, is that same thing inside Eren. If it has none, what was the power that lifted the boulder yesterday. They reached no answer. One thing was already clear. Once that question stayed in the city, Eren could not be kept as an ordinary wounded soldier.

segments.titleEn: The room where he opens his eyes
segments.ja: エレンが目を開けたのは、戦場ではなく、鍵のかかる部屋でした。手足は戻りかけていて、それ自体が人間離れしています。彼は夢の残りを掴もうとします。地下室、鍵、父の声。形になる前に、現実の鎖が腕に当たります。ミカサとアルミンは扉の外にいます。中に入れる権限は、もう友達の側にはありません。エレンが最初に理解したのは、作戦が終わったことではなく、自分が所属を失ったことでした。
segments.en: Eren opened his eyes not on the battlefield but in a locked room. His limbs were growing back, and that alone set him apart from other humans. He tried to hold what was left of a dream. A basement. A key. His father's voice. Before it took a shape, a real chain touched his arm. Mikasa and Armin were outside the door. The right to come in no longer belonged to his friends. The first thing Eren understood was not that the operation was over. It was that he no longer belonged anywhere.

segments.ja: その部屋に、調査兵団の団長エルヴィン・スミスが来ます。壁の外へ出る翼のマークが、狭い廊下では大きく見えました。エルヴィンはエレンを怖がりません。同時に、慰めもしません。彼が見ているのは、穴を塞いだ実績と、まだ使っていない領土奪還の可能性です。自由のため、という言葉は彼の口では熱くありません。計算として置かれます。エレンはその静けさに、ピクシスとは違う種類の決断を感じました。
segments.en: Erwin Smith, Commander of the Survey Corps, came to that room. The wings that ride outside the walls looked large in a narrow hall. Erwin was not afraid of Eren. He also did not comfort him. What he looked at was the proven fact of a plugged hole, and the unused possibility of retaking land. In his mouth, the phrase for the sake of freedom was not hot. It was set down as a calculation. In that calm, Eren felt a kind of decision different from Pyxis.

segments.ja: エルヴィンだけが、エレンを見ているのではありません。憲兵の側は、予測できない力を街の中に置いておけないと言います。研究するなら解剖が早い、処分するなら今だ、という声もあります。駐屯兵団は、昨日の成功を盾にします。調査兵団は、これから先の作戦を盾にします。どの盾も、エレンの意思を中心には置いていません。本人が何を望むかは、審議のあとでいい、という空気でした。
segments.en: Erwin was not the only one looking at Eren. The Military Police side said an unpredictable power could not be left inside the city. Some voices said that if he was to be studied, dissection was faster, and if he was to be disposed of, now was the time. The Garrison held up yesterday's success. The Survey Corps held up the operations still to come. None of those shields put Eren's will at the center. The air in the room said his own wish could wait until after the hearing.

segments.en: Mikasa was prepared to stand at the door until she was let in. Armin pulled her shoulder and explained, briefly, that a scene here would stop them being counted as Eren's allies. Mikasa did not accept it. Her feet stopped anyway. Armin was translating his hypothesis into political language. To prove Eren human, feeling was not enough. The regiments needed a result they could use. The translation was accurate, and it was cold.

segments.en: At night Jean saw Marco's name still in the column of the unrecovered. The classmates from training had split into the living and the ones who were only a line on paper. segments.ja: エレンは鎖の音を聞きながら、自分の欲求を探します。巨人になりたいのではない。壁の外を見たい。父の地下室の意味を知りたい。仲間をこれ以上、名簿にしたくない。その三つは、巨人の原初の欲求とは別のものに思えました。別だと証明する方法は、まだありません。明朝、彼は審議の場へ運ばれます。調査兵団がその場にいることだけが、今夜のわずかな手がかりでした。
segments.en: Listening to the chain, Eren looked for his own desire. He did not want to be a Titan. He wanted to see past the walls. He wanted to know what his father's basement meant. He did not want any more friends turned into lines on a list. Those three things felt different from a Titan's primal desire. He still had no way to prove the difference. In the morning he would be carried to a hearing. The only small clue tonight was that the Survey Corps would be in the room.

segments.en: At the end of recovery there is fire. Titan corpses are too large to bury, and human corpses are handled separately after the names are checked. Smoke changes the color of the wall. Soldiers take turns standing upwind, and the smell still stays in their clothes. Jean tried to get used to it and refused to succeed. He felt that if he got used to it, the hand searching for Marco would slow down. The fire was work for the sake of sanitation, not a funeral rite. Nobody was saying anymore that they should make time for a rite.

segments.en: The dream Eren sees in the locked room does not finish. His father's back. The metal of a key. The spine of a book. And the feeling that he is crying after some injection. When he wakes, none of it is evidence. He knows that if he tells Armin, the dream will be treated as lighter than the operation's result. He still repeats the single word basement so he will not forget it. Apart from a Titan's desire, a piece of homework has stayed on the human side. Only a feeling remains, that the place of that homework might be under the house in Shiganshina.

segments.titleEn: The decision to take him to the capital
segments.ja: エレンをこの街に置いたままにはできない、という判断が夜のあいだに固まります。トロストの兵は彼を見すぎた。見すぎた街では、噂が命令より先に走ります。だから審議は、もっと上の人間がいる場所で行う。調査兵団はその移動に同行する権利を主張し、憲兵の側は監視の人数を要求します。エレンは荷物のように行き先を告げられます。ミカサは同行を求め、すぐには許されません。許されないことが、これから先の形を先に見せていました。
segments.en: During the night a decision hardened: Eren could not be left in this city. The soldiers of Trost had seen too much of him. In a city that has seen too much, rumor runs ahead of orders. So the hearing would be held where the people above them were. The Survey Corps claimed the right to travel with him. The Military Police side demanded a number of guards. Eren was told his destination the way cargo is told. Mikasa asked to go with him and was not allowed at once. Not being allowed showed, early, the shape of what was coming.

segments.en: By the time the wagon was ready, Jean still had the recovery list. Hearing that Eren was going to the capital, he felt relief and abandonment at the same time. A city without the classmate who had a Titan's power would go back, a little, to being ordinary. Going back to ordinary was not a reason to stop looking for Marco. Sasha did the cooking, which did not smell of bread, without complaining. Connie tried one joke, failed, and stopped. The job of the classmates left behind was not to see a hero off. It was to keep the name column open tomorrow too.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。回収は、戦いのあとに遺体と装備を集める仕事です。調査兵団は、壁の外へ出る兵団で、団長はエルヴィンです。意思は、巨人にあるのか、エレンにまだあるのか、という問いの中心です。自由は、翼のマークが約束しているように見えて、まだ手元にないものです。マルコは、ジャンが探している同期です。原初の欲求は、空腹以上の、人へ向かう衝動を指して使いました。この夜のエレンは、その衝動とは違う何かを、鎖の中で探していました。
segments.en: Today's words. Recovery is the work of gathering bodies and gear after a battle. The Survey Corps is the regiment that goes outside the walls, and its Commander is Erwin. Will is the center of the question: does a Titan have one, and does Eren still. Freedom is what the wings seem to promise, and what nobody is holding yet. Marco is the classmate Jean is searching for. Primal desire, here, means an urge toward humans that is more than hunger. On this night, in chains, Eren was searching for something that was not that urge.

In the morning he would be carried to a hearing. The only small clue tonight was that the Survey Corps would be in the room.

vocab.exampleJa: 作戦の成功は、この回収が終わるまで、誰の口にもうまく乗りませんでした。
vocab.exampleEn: The hole was closed. Trost District still did not look like a city that had won. Titan corpses and human corpses lay on the same streets, facing the same way. The Garrison began the work of recovery. Blades, bodies, names that could be read and names that could not. The smell of smoke climbed as far as the top of the wall. Success did not sit easily in anyone's mouth until that work was finished. It was not finished.

vocab.exampleJa: 形になる前に、現実の鎖が腕に当たります。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren opened his eyes not on the battlefield but in a locked room. His limbs were growing back, and that alone set him apart from other humans. He tried to hold what was left of a dream. A basement. A key. His father's voice. Before it took a shape, a real chain touched his arm. Mikasa and Armin were outside the door. The right to come in no longer belonged to his friends. The first thing Eren understood was not that the operation was over. It was that he no longer belonged anywhere.

vocab.exampleJa: 回収の合間に、兵たちは低い声で話します。
vocab.exampleEn: Between loads of the dead, the soldiers talked in low voices. Why does a Titan eat a person. Is it hunger, or a primal desire that only walks toward humans. If a Titan has a will, is that same thing inside Eren. If it has none, what was the power that lifted the boulder yesterday. They reached no answer. One thing was already clear. Once that question stayed in the city, Eren could not be kept as an ordinary wounded soldier.

vocab.exampleJa: 片腕と片足はなく、体は熱のあとで震えています。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren Jaeger was pulled out of the Titan's nape in a human shape. One arm and one leg were gone, and the body shook with the heat it had left. Mikasa wiped blood. Armin counted breaths. Neither of them could say whether they were recovering a friend or recovering the inside of a weapon. Eren's unconscious face looked younger than it had during yesterday's operation. The soldiers around them tried not to look at it for long.

vocab.exampleJa: 壁の外へ出る翼のマークが、狭い廊下では大きく見えました。
vocab.exampleEn: Erwin Smith, Commander of the Survey Corps, came to that room. The wings that ride outside the walls looked large in a narrow hall. Erwin was not afraid of Eren. He also did not comfort him. What he looked at was the proven fact of a plugged hole, and the unused possibility of retaking land. In his mouth, the phrase for the sake of freedom was not hot. It was set down as a calculation. In that calm, Eren felt a kind of decision different from Pyxis.

The work of recovery does not wait long for a missing person.
